def dispatch(self, ids=None, suite=None, run_anyway=False, completed_results=None):
        if self.controller.busy:
            return
        from .window_placement import browser_anchor
        browser = dict(self.controller.local.get('browser', {}))
        browser['_window_anchor'] = browser_anchor(self.root)
        self.controller.local['browser'] = browser
        if self.controller.start(ids,suite,run_anyway,self.email_results.get(),completed_results):
            self.status.set('Running — browser/network work is in the background')
            self.mail_status.set('Result email pending' if self.email_results.get() else 'Result email OFF')
            self.set_busy_controls('disabled')
